images.author: Andino
images.why: Explicitly identified ground-level view of Guayaques from Bolivia, with an abandoned bus in the foreground. Rare non-Wikimedia candidate; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Luis Salazar Vargas
images.why: Named view of Láscar and its broad active crater from San Pedro de Atacama. Aguas Calientes is farther behind on the left; centre the crop on Láscar. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Luis Salazar Vargas
images.why: Sunset view of Láscar from Solor, offering stronger evening colour and a recognisable volcanic profile. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Cristián Arriagada
images.why: Explicitly captioned south-face view of Láscar from Laguna Lejía, matching the requested classic viewpoint. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Moisés Fonseca
images.why: 6000 × 4000 photograph identified as Pico de Orizaba from Puebla, with clear sky and trees framing the mountain; ample resolution for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Said L
images.why: 4755 × 3170 photograph of the snow-capped volcano above lush greenery under a clear sky; strong natural colour and generous cropping resolution.

images.author: Frank Ixtepan
images.why: 5184 × 3456 twilight photograph from Xalapa, with blue-hour colour and the volcano’s silhouette. Atmospheric alternative, with less visible snow and surface detail.

images.author: Jack Brauer
images.why: Professional landscape photograph explicitly identifying Volcán Isluga in its national park. Photographer-hosted large image; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Alejandra Ardilla
images.why: “Isluga amaneciendo,” photographed looking north: a sunrise candidate with reliable named-volcano attribution. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Felipe Lobos
images.why: Identified view of Isluga looking north from the old village of Carahuano, on the Chilean side. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Official tourism photograph associated specifically with Yucamani/Yucamane in Candarave, providing a dependable identity reference and volcanic profile. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Jorge Valle del Carpio
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Yucamani, Candarave–Tacna, photographed in April 2013. Lower-resolution fallback: the exposed image is a display copy; a ≥2000 px original was not verified.
